citation: P. Manjunath, T. Prüfer, Gunaseelan S, K. Durai and N. K. R. Chichili, "Grid-Connection-Aware Scheduling of AI Data Centres with Green Hydrogen and Quantum-Assisted Workload Placement," Procedia Computer Science (accepted, to appear), 5th Int. Conf. on Machine Learning and Data Engineering (ICMLDE 2026), Paper ID 1939.
code_citation: QH2DC reproducibility package (MATLAB + Python cross-check, 168-h benchmark), P. Manjunath et al., 2026.

solver.hourly_dispatch: independent reference MILP, SciPy milp / HiGHS (verify/verify_python.py, scripts/export_dispatch.py); weekly totals equal the published table

generator.note: The benchmark has no nameplate parameter; these are generator settings and observed maxima.

known_differences_from_manuscript: R2 CO2: published table 242.64 t (schedule solved at the reported 10.59 MW cap); manuscript 242.25 t is the uncapped R2 schedule.
Solar / wind: manuscript Table 1 lists 4.0 MW / 3.0 MW; the benchmark generator uses an 8.6 MW clear-sky amplitude and wind bounded to 0.3-5.0 MW.
banner: Synthetic 168-h benchmark · decision support, not a site forecast · QAOA is an exact simulation, no quantum advantage claimed
